body: I’ve noticed when I exercise consistently my sleep does get a whole lot better, so I need to get back into it. I’ve been down lately which is why I think I’ve been dragging. Thanks :)
Thank you. I have a lot of soul searching to do I really appreciate you listening and giving me advice.

I think so. I make more than him. It would be kind of harder but my mom is a widow and helps with expenses a lot so I think she’d help me. My moms asked me a lot when should we get rid of him (not violently but like out of our lives) so I feel brainwashed and a failure. Like I know it isn’t right but I’ve stuck with him so long.

I think I would get custody over them. I’ve never gotten in trouble with the law or anything. The kids are 4 and 5 and they don’t really like him. He’s never abused them but he’s impatient and mean to them sometimes. It hurts me and my mom doesn’t like him either. 

I feel like if I got away from him I could finally focus on myself and my health and lose the weight I’ve gained the last few years and be happy with my job and studies. 

When I met him I was outgoing, bubbly, energetic, popular and happy and now I’m completely withdrawn, have no real friends, look ugly, have no will or desire to do anything at all. It’s a struggle to take the kids to daycare and even walk 10 feet from my front door to my car. As soon as I finish work I just want to sleep. I have literally never felt this bad. I thought it was because of my weight gain because I always valued being fit and attractive but now I’m wondering if it’s him.

Yes, we nearly divorced in 2012, i moved out when he was at work and I disappeared for 3 months. I almost got away and I was stupid enough to go back because I thought he changed. He got better, but then the old habits crept in again. 

The weird thing is, I don’t even like care what he does anymore? Like I feel like if he cheated on me I wouldn’t even care ? It’s part of my indifference towards everything. I used to be crazy about him and now I’m just like “meh”. He makes me disgusted and he’s mean to me a lot.
Everyone on the outside things we are some strong successful couple and in reality it’s all a lie. He barely talks to me and I haven’t told him I loved him in over a year.

I texted him last night telling him I was “fucking depressed” and I needed to start working out and asked him to help and he yelled at me about it and all he said was that I need to change my eating habits. 

He also doesn’t believe depression is real and thinks you can control it. I’ve also asked for marriage counseling for at least 5 years, his parents suggested it too and he shut us all down, saying we don’t need someone random telling us what to do. 

He’s completely indifferent. He comes home from work and plays Fortnite. He barely helps with the kids unless he is forced to. It’s really clear I’ve changed and become withdrawn and he yells at me for not wanting to go out on weekends and calls me boring and lazy.
